hint.en: Triggers when the ConnectModule reports a new location while the bike is idle (not charging and not being ridden). The ConnectModule reports when the bike is powered on, charging, or its motion alarm fires - so an unexpected report can indicate the bike is being moved. Enable Bosch eBike Lock so a thief cannot simply power on and ride, which would suppress this card; the 'eBike location updated' card fires unconditionally if you prefer your own conditions. Requires a ConnectModule with the eBike Alarm feature. Detection is delayed by the polling interval (up to 5 minutes).
